jobs_results.title: Administrador bbdd (ms sql server/ssis)
jobs_results.description:
KRELL CONSULTING, desearía incorporar a su equipo, a un ADMINISTRADOR BBDD (Ms SQL Server/Ssis), para trabajar en Barcelona.

Perfil: Experto en MS SQL SERVER y SSIS

REQUERIDO:

Conocimientos imprescindibles :

Especializado en Microsoft SQL Server y SSIS que sea capaz de llevar a cabo las siguientes tareas:

FUNCIONES:

• Configuración de dos nuevas instancias de servidor SQL Server 2019. Para ello se tomará como base un servidor SQL Server 2016 ya existente. Entre otras tareas, se deberá configurar el sistema de backups, importar los usuarios existentes, configurar linked servers, configurar el envío de correos y otras tareas relacionadas.

• Migración Bases de Datos de SQL Server 2016 a SQL Server 2019 aumentando el compatibility level a 150 (actualmente CL =100).

• Testear las conexiones.

Se deberá coordinar el testeo de las conexiones del nuevo servidor SQL Servidor 2019 con servidores de terceras partes.

• Migración de paquetes SSIS.

Actualmente existe un conjunto de... paquetes basados en SSIS 2008 que cargan datos al servidor SQL Server 2016. Estos paquetes deben ser migrados a la nueva versión SSIS 2019 y hacer un deploy al nuevo servidor SQL Server 2019 para que se ejecuten desde el propio servidor.

• Los paquetes utilizan un add-on llamado Xtract. Estos paquetes SSIS deberán ser convertidos siguiendo las instrucciones del fabricante.

• Testear los paquetes SSIS migrados contra un nuevo sistema fuente y, cuando sea necesario, adaptarlos teniendo en cuenta las diferencias entre sistemas fuente.

• Preparar corte de operaciones para migrar las bases de datos productivas al nuevo servidor (previamente testeado) y hacer monitorización del mismo.

• Monitorizar el rendimiento del nuevo servidor y realizar los ajustes necesarios para mantener un buen nivel de performance.

• Monitorizar la ejecución de paquetes SSIS en el nuevo servidor y montar sistema de alertas.

• Colaborar en la preparación de un dashboard, preferiblemente en Power BI, para poder monitorizar las cargas que, a partir del go-live, se ejecutarán en el nuevo SQL Server 2019.

• Preparar nuevos paquetes SSIS para atender a los nuevos requerimientos de negocio.

• Documentar todas las tareas realizadas y los paquetes SSIS migrados

¡Hola! Somos ARATECH Lifestyle Technology, una empresa con más de 10 años de experiencia en informática y consultoría. El grupo de profesionales que trabaja en ARATECH tiene como misión ofrecer las mejores soluciones a nuestros clientes trabajando junto a ellos en su Transformación Digital para proveer del mejor asesoramiento estableciendo una colaboración estrecha.

Una Consultora con ADN DIGITAL especializada en el Desarrollo de Software a medida, Selección de Personal y Directivos, Marketing Digital y Sistemas & Cloud. Somos creadores, hacemos realidad las ideas de nuestros clientes y damos humanidad a la tecnología. Buscamos el Talento IT que quiera participar con nosotros en la transformación digital que la realidad necesita.

¿Con quién trabajamos? 🤝🏢

Actualmente estamos trabajando con una de las empresas líderes dentro del sector IT a nivel mundial. Tienes la oportunidad de colaborar con ellos en un gran proyecto.

Juntos estamos buscando un DBA SQL ... NoSQL para que se incorpore a ARATECH y trabaje junto al equipo de nuestro gran partner.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?📚📑

Participarás en un proyecto Internacional de IaaS y Transformación a Cloud de servicios de infraestructura de las áreas de cliente y sus torres tecnológicas.

Tareas:
• Operación de ejecución de Microsoft SQL/Cluster
• Ser el punto de contacto para comunicaciones externas e internas.
• Incidente/problema/cambio/alineación de SR de la operación de ejecución de base de datos estándar con el cliente realizando comprobaciones de estado para los cambios de parámetros de alineación de los sistemas
• Identificar oportunidades de automatización
• Garantizar que los entregables cumplan con los estándares de calidad.

Requisitos:
• Conocimiento en Microsoft SQL (valorable conocimiento en versiones 2005, 2008, 2012, 2016).
• Buenas habilidades de Windows.
• Conocimiento en sistemas operativos (WS, Linux, Unix).
• Conocimiento en bases de datos (Oracle, SQLServer, PostgreSQL, Exadata/ExaCC, MariaDB-MongoDB), SAP (Oracle, Hana) almacenamiento y backup,
• Conocimiento herramientas de monitorización.
• Buenas habilidades de comunicación, presentación, reporting y dotes de liderazgo.
• Habilidad para resolución de problemas.
• Inglés: mínimo B2.

¿Qué ofrecemos?💙⭐
• 🤗Contratación con ARATECH, indefinida a jornada completa.
• 💻Modalidad de trabajo híbrido: 2 días de teletrabajo.
• 🏠Oficinas en Málaga y Madrid.
• 😎 Excelente clima laboral y cultura de trabajo en equipo.
• 📚 Formación continuada con cursos y certificaciones.
• 🌃Trabajar junto a una empresa líder dentro del sector IT.

¡¡NO DUDES EN FORMAR PARTE DE NUESTRO EQUIPO

jobs_results.title: Database Administrator
jobs_results.description:
Database Administrator in the RIA Money Transfer Global DBA Team in the Spain shift and office

• This is a MS SQL Server DBA role largely responsible for providing operational database services to the organization.

• Primary responsibilities of this role includes owning, tracking and resolving database related incidents and requests within provided SLAs, reviewing service related reports primarily but not limited to the Production and KC/DR Data Center database servers and services (e.g.: database backups, maintenance, monitoring) on a daily basis to ensure service related issues are identified and resolved within established SLAs, responding to database related alerts and escalations and working with database engineering to come up with strategic solutions to recurring problems.

• Ensuring and maintaining the readiness and operability in the Production and KC/DR datacenter database servers for the Ria Financial databases. Actual readiness and availability in the KC DR datacenter... in the actual event of the Production database systems failover from the LA production data center to ensure the business continuity of the Ria Financial databases running in the KC data center

• High sense of ownership of the problems and requests assigned, focus on managing and resolving issues in alignment with the SLAs, establishing and maintaining communication with technology customers to keep them updated with status of their requests, initiating and performing changes on production systems and proactively escalating any issues that cannot be resolved within the established timeframes.

• The MS SQL Server DBA will be part of the Production DBA Team, which is required to follow an on-site/on-call rotation including weekends to support the production environment.

Qualifications

• At least 3 years experience as a Microsoft SQL Server DBA in SQL Server 2014 and above

• Experience with SQL Server Replication.

• Experience in Performance Tuning and Optimization using monitoring and troubleshooting tools

• Experience in troubleshooting and resolving database problems.

• Experience with SQL Server Integration/Reporting Services.

• Experience/knowledge of Log Shipping

• Knowledge of High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) options for MSSQL Server.

• Knowledge of indexes, index management, and statistics.

• Experience writing at least basic T-SQL queries and reports

• Experience in implementing operational automation using scripts.

• Experience working with Windows server, including Active Directory and proper disk configurations.

• Pro-active monitoring of databases both from a performance and capacity management perspective.

• Perform database maintenance activities such as backup/recovery, replication, rebuilding and reorganizing indexes.

• Experience in troubleshooting and resolving database integrity issues, performance issues, blocking/deadlocking issues, connectivity issues, data replication issues etc.

• Experience with using SQL Profiler or Server Side Traces/Extended Events to help troubleshoot performance bottlenecks

• Ability to detect and troubleshoot and resolve database related CPU, memory, I/O, disk space and other resource contention issues.

• Experience supporting and managing SQL Server databases in a 24x7 production environment

• Familiarity with release and change management principles and processes.

• Proficiency in capturing and analyzing requirements, presenting alternative solutions, recommending the appropriate design, developing the solution to meet the requirements and exceed customer expectation and maintaining the required documentation.

• Excellent organizational and workflow skills; ability to work on simultaneous projects with diverse working groups

• Team player with collaborative nature

• Ability to work independently with little to no supervision in operational database projects

• 4-year degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience

• Knowledge of productivity tools and software such as Office and Visio

• Pro-active monitoring of databases both from a performance and capacity management perspective.

• Perform database maintenance activities such as backup/recovery, replication, rebuilding and reorganizing indexes.

• Experience in troubleshooting and resolving database integrity issues, performance issues, blocking/deadlocking issues, connectivity issues, data replication issues etc.

• Experience with using SQL Profiler or Server Side Traces/Extended Events to help troubleshoot performance bottlenecks

• Ability to detect and troubleshoot and resolve database related CPU, memory, I/O, disk space and other resource contention issues.

• Experience supporting and managing SQL Server databases in a 24x7 production environment

• Familiarity with release and change management principles and processes.

• Proficiency in capturing and analyzing requirements, presenting alternative solutions, recommending the appropriate design, developing the solution to meet the requirements and exceed customer expectation and maintaining the required documentation.

• Excellent organizational and workflow skills; ability to work on simultaneous projects with diverse working groups

• Team player with collaborative nature

• Ability to work independently with little to no supervision in operational database projects

• 4-year degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience

• Knowledge of productivity tools and software such as Office and Visio

T-Systems somos un equipo de alrededor 28.000 empleados en todo el mundo, siendo más de 3.000 compañeros en España. Esto nos convierte en uno de los principales proveedores mundiales de soluciones integradas de extremo a extremo. Desarrollamos soluciones de cloud híbrida, inteligencia artificial e impulsamos la transformación digital de las empresas, la industria, el sector público y en definitiva, de toda la sociedad.

En esta ocasión buscamos un nuevo compañero/a especialista senior en bases de datos SQL Server. Trabajará en nuestro producto interno GIMM; una solución de T-Systems creada para sincronizar cadenas de suministro en el sector automoción, dando soporte a distribuidores en más de 80 fábricas por todo el mundo. La persona que se incorpore tendrá una formación exhaustiva en el producto, ya que GIMM es un proyecto a largo plazo y muy completo.

No buscamos un profesional en una localización concreta, por lo que valoraremos candidaturas de distintos lugares de España.

🧑💻... ¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?
• Optimización de BBDD e identificación de potenciales mejoras en las BBDD existentes.
• Resolución de incongruencias entre los registros de las BBDD.
• En un medio plazo, trabajarás junto con parte del equipo en la migración de bases de datos a nube pública. No es necesario que tengas conocimiento previo de cloud porque te formaríamos en este aspecto.
• Soporte técnico al equipo interno y cobertura de incidencias.

🔎¿Qué buscamos?
• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en gestión y administración de BBDD SQL.
• Imprescindible nivel alto/profesional de inglés: la mayoría de la jornada laboral se desarrolla en este idioma.
• Gusto por el trabajo en equipo.
• Proyección laboral: queremos incorporar un profesional que busque estabilidad y permanecer en un proyecto grande y complejo a largo plazo.

Aunque no son requisitos imprescindibles, valoramos muy positivamente tener conocimientos técnicos en:
• Windows Server
• T-SQL
• Azure cloud

• Proyecto internacional
• Salario acorde a la experiencia y conocimientos aportados
• Formación continua

• Seguro de vida y accidentes

jobs_results.title: Database Engineer (SQL Server)
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are

The Workshop is a tech company that develops intuitive software for the online gaming industry. Our motto is to move “Fearlessly Forward” together. Cooperative innovation is at the center of everything we do – from our games, new products and technologies, to how we collaborate and share inspiration with one another.

Within The Workshop, Core Tech is the supporting function that works closely with Engineering and Operations teams and to participate in the decision making process for defining the future of the company. From DevOps to Architecture and Engineering Security, they help in driving the projects to the next level, ensuring that the requirements meet the expectations adding value to the process.

The DevOps group is made of three different teams, among which Database Engineering is, whose mission is to drive improvements, whether they relate to boosting enjoyment of the software or the efficiency of our systems. Working for the teams who make and deliver our... software, you’ll make sure everything we do is effective across development and production environments.

As a team of specialists, we provide the tools and time for learning as well as a personal training budget.

What You'll Do
• As a Microsoft SQL Server Engineer, you will administer our database platforms to ensure they remain online, secure, right-sized and have appropriate HA/DR solutions.
• You will support our development lifecycle through feasibility, design and delivery to ensure the solutions we provide are automated, robust, scalable, maintainable and secure.
• You will promote and collaborate in the creation of solutions to drive automation, environment consistency, continuous delivery with an "everything as code" mentality.
• When appropriate you will lead on complex database tasks such as Information Lifecycle Management, very large table modifications, advanced query tuning and data-migrations
• Use your training budget and work time to keep up to date, and sometimes drive industry data platform trends and technology adoption.
• Collaborate with colleagues, application development teams, and with business stakeholders.
• Cross train peers in database development and administration. They will do the same for you.
• Provide out of hours production support as part of a 24/7 rota.

What You'll Bring
• 3+ years experience supporting Microsoft SQL Server in a business critical Production Environment
• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
• Solid understanding of Microsoft SQL Server database architecture, data modeling, and performance tuning.
• Proficiency in Microsoft SQL administration, including installation, configuration, patching and troubleshooting.
• Experience with database monitoring tools and performance optimisation techniques
• Experience with configuration management tools such us Puppet or Ansible (nice to have)
• Experience with SQL Server on Linux is definitely a plus

What's In It For You
• Inspiring and fulfilling work at an innovative and values-driven company creating cutting-edge tech
• Attractive salary and customisable benefits package
• Flexible working hours and ways of working
• Contemporary and accessible office environments with a range of workplace perks
• Six weeks’ paid leave for every four years of service
• Relocation package for you and your family including soft-landing package services to help you settle in (applicable in Spain, if you are moving from a different city/country)
• Being part of a team with a forward-looking, international mindset and agile working practices
• A friendly, inclusive and multicultural environment (we are made up of over 35 nationalities, speaking almost 30 languages)
• Wellbeing programmes, learning and personal growth opportunities
• A range of employee events throughout the year, including team building activities, Learning Labs, Hackathons and Designathons
• Opportunities to shape the tech community within and outside of the company, through mentoring and knowledge-sharing

Our values

We understand that great ideas come from great people, and great people thrive when they’re trusted to challenge, change, improve, and perfect our products and processes. Our forte lies in the diversity of our skills – and that comes from the diversity of our people.

The Workshop is committed to being a diverse and inclusive workplace, where we all learn together, trust each other, and value collaboration. We welcome candidates of all genders, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, nationality, belief (or lack thereof), and programming language preference. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer a friendly, supportive working environment for all. It’s a place where you can try new ideas, take risks, and enjoy the support to move Fearlessly Forward

jobs_results.title: Microsoft SQL Server DBA
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Aleson ITC is a team of Microsoft certified consultants specialized in developing and implementing customized SQL Server database solutions to suit various IT environment needs. We offer a full spectrum of solutions to solve database challenges of any size, and can help you leverage your technology investment through effective database architecture and design. Our company is located in Sagunto (Valencia, Spain).

The Company is a Microsoft partnered managed service provider who are looking for an experienced SQL Server DBA to join their team. The organization is going through a period of significant growth and are working with several highly renowned clients to support them with their SQL Server requirements. You will work collaboratively with a team of like-minded DBAs with the goal to effectively resolve all client needs within a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities
• Work on installing, configuring and supporting High Availability and Disaster Recovery... environments.
• Analyze Partner data to develop an understanding of performance and to highlight possible changes or opportunities to increase performance and partner growth.
• Work alongside and collaborate with Service Desk and Delivery to ensure processes and communication are clear and aligned.
• Identify bottlenecks and bugs and devise solutions to resolve.
• Provide Azure Cloud support with clients Azure SQL Databases, Azure VM's and Azure Managed Instances.

Previous experience working as a SQL Server DBA
• +4 years like SQL Server DBA.
• Strong understanding of database maintenance operations
• Strong T-SQL skills
• Experience with SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery setups
• Experience working within an Azure cloud setup supporting Azure SQL databases, VMs and managed instances.
• Distributed source control systems (Git, Mercurial etc.)
• Microsoft SSIS/ETL experience (Desirable)
• Jira (Desirable)
• MongoDB (Desirable)
• PostgreSQL (Desirable)

Required Skills and Experience
• Strong communication skills to engage with internal and external stakeholders.
• Good technical knowledge of databases and query languages
• Be able to understand, communicate, interpret information with IT to manage, report, assist in the build of performance reporting.
• Adept with organizing and prioritizing work commitments and hitting tight deadlines.
• Experienced in identifying and analyzing trends whilst providing solutions to problems.
• Strong written and oral communication skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills and experience of working in a team.
• Good understanding of customer service.

This organization is focused on the training and development of each member of the team. You will be given the opportunity to complete funded Microsoft certifications and training courses that can help develop your skill set further. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a dedicated, specialist team with the opportunity to work on interesting projects and further develop your skills.

This is just a brief overview of the role. For the full information, simply apply to the role with your CV, and we will call you to discuss further. We are looking to begin the interview process ASAP, so don't miss out, APPLY now
